# Mr. Chartist API Bridge

> One local API (REST, WebSocket and MCP) in front of your Indian broker accounts. It runs on the user's own computer, keeps one connection per broker, shares it between all of the user's tools and stays inside each broker's rate limits. Orders are paper by default; live orders need several explicit opt-ins. MIT licensed. Broker market data is for the account holder's own use, as the broker terms say.

Facts that help when writing code against it:

- Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:4300` (this computer only). `mc-bridge start --demo` serves sample data with no broker, for trying things out.
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer mcb_<keyId>_<secret>`. Scopes: `read`, `paper` (read plus paper orders), `live`, `admin` (this computer only). Keys come from `mc-bridge keys create`; never put one in a URL, except `?key=` on `/xl/*` for read-only keys.
- Symbols: `EXCHANGE:UNDERLYING[-YYYY-MM-DD(-FUT | -STRIKE-CE | -STRIKE-PE)]`, for example `NSE:RELIANCE`, `NSE:NIFTY`, `NFO:NIFTY-2026-10-27-25000-CE`.
- Answers under `/v1` are `{ "data": ..., "meta": { "requestId": ... } }`. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code` and a `retryable` flag. Send an `Idempotency-Key` with every order write.
- Every market-data item has a `freshness` block (source, age, `class` realtime, delayed or eod). Delayed and end-of-day data is never used for orders, risk checks, paper fills or alerts.
- Orders are paper unless the request says `"mode": "live"` and every live opt-in is in place. Approving an order always happens on the computer running the Bridge, never through a spreadsheet, chart alert or chat message.

## Start here

- [Docs home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/README.md): where to begin, by what you want to do
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/quickstart.md): clone, start in demo mode, make a key, get a price, place a paper order, read a stream
- [Connect a tool](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/mcp.md): Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor over MCP; other tools are listed in the docs home
- [Safety](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/safety.md): paper and live modes, keys, limits, kill switch, audit

## API reference

- [OpenAPI 3.1 description](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/openapi.yaml): all 212 operations with schemas, scopes and error codes
- [AsyncAPI description](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/asyncapi.yaml): WebSocket and SSE message formats
- [Endpoint pages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/api/README.md): one Markdown page per operation (212), grouped by area, each with curl and Python examples
- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/api/errors.md): every stable error code with its HTTP status and whether a retry is safe
- [Postman and Bruno collections](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/collections/README.md): import every request, with paper-mode examples and no real keys

## Guides

- [Quickstart: five minutes to a first answer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/quickstart.md): Clone, start in demo mode, make a key, get a price, place a paper order, read a stream; and what to do when it does not work
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/faq.md): Is it free, is my broker supported, why pooling is off, why Yahoo is not real-time, where the data lives, how to reset
- [Installing the Bridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/install.md): Installing in one step on Windows, Mac or Linux (no Node.js, no admin password), updating, uninstalling
- [Data downloads](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/downloads.md): Saving history to files (CSV, JSONL, AmiBroker), datasets that update from their last bar, the API budget share, and the estimate before you start
- [Backup and restore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/backup.md): Backing up and restoring your data, the copy made before an upgrade, the daily backup, and a recovery runbook (disk died, wrong upgrade, new computer)
- [Connect a tool](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/connect.md): The dashboard's Connect a tool page: pick Excel, an AI assistant, a script or AmiBroker, get a key with only the access it needs and the setup to paste
- [Brokers and multiple accounts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/accounts.md): Adding brokers and several accounts, logging in, sessions, family accounts
- [How the Bridge handles broker rate limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/rate-limits.md): How the Bridge stays inside every broker's limits, spreading reads over your own accounts
- [Data sources: where prices come from, and how the Bridge labels them](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/sources.md): Where prices come from: your brokers, optional free sources and plugins, what delayed, end-of-day and unofficial mean, how to turn a source on
- [Paper margin: how the Bridge estimates it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/paper-margin.md): How the paper engine estimates margin for F&O positions
- [Compat REST and WebSocket API (/api/v1)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/compat-api.md): /api/v1 apikey-in-body REST and WebSocket for existing algo tools and SDKs
- [Live streaming: WebSocket and SSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/streaming.md): WebSocket and SSE live data
- [Events out: react to the Bridge without polling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/events.md): Bridge events out without polling: SSE and WebSocket with cursor replay, signed webhooks with retries and dead letters, receiver code for Node, Python and the shell
- [Alerts: TradingView, signed generic hooks, ChartInk and GoCharting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/webhooks.md): TradingView, signed generic, ChartInk and GoCharting alerts
- [Orders for alerts, sheets and scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/alert-orders.md): Target-size and basket orders, MIS/NRML words, symbol check, basket margin, market calendar
- [Telegram: alerts on your phone, and prices when you ask](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/telegram.md): Alerts on your phone and read-only price and status commands: BotFather steps, which events, safety stance, troubleshooting
- [Notifications: how the Bridge tells you things](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/notifications.md): How a message travels (outbox, retries, pacing, quiet hours), the notify settings and routes
- [Recording: save prices and option chains as they happen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/recording.md): Saving real-time prices and option chains to files on your computer, by hand or by rules every trading day: market hours, gaps, disk limits, retention, the file layout, saving API calls
- [AmiBroker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/amibroker.md): AmiBroker AFL and ASCII import
- [Building on the Bridge: the developer guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/developers.md): Start in five minutes, starters (mc-bridge init), auth and scopes, limits and retries, errors, pagination, idempotency, events, data downloads, versioning promise
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/python.md): Python SDK
- [TypeScript and Node](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/typescript.md): Node and TypeScript SDK
- [Collections: lists of instruments and option universes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/collections.md): Named, tagged lists of instruments and option universes (rolling expiry, ATM strike) for downloads, recordings, sheets and Python; import, export, size estimate
- [Excel and Google Sheets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/excel-sheets.md): Excel WEBSERVICE, Power Query, Google Sheets
- [AI assistants over MCP (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/mcp.md): Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor (MCP)
- [ChatGPT and OpenAI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/chatgpt-openai.md): ChatGPT and OpenAI function calling
- [Letting TradingView (and a Google Sheet) reach the Bridge safely](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/expose-alerts.md): Letting TradingView alerts and a Google Sheet reach the Bridge through a tunnel or proxy without exposing the dashboard: mc-bridge expose, the safe layout, provider recipes, tests
- [Running the Bridge on a VPS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/vps.md): A hardened VPS recipe: firewall, systemd or Docker, reaching the dashboard, static IP registration and change planning, updating, backups
- [Deployment: static IP, daily login and the readiness check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/deployment.md): Static IP for live orders (ISP, VPS, VPN), the daily login and the trading-readiness badge
- [Safety model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/safety.md): Paper and live modes, keys, limits, kill switch, audit
- [Compliance notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MrChartist/api-bridge-v2/main/docs/guides/compliance.md): SEBI, exchange and broker rules that shape the design (with needs-verification flags)
